reason_for_single_correction: v1 preserved luminance and looked plausible but failed the pre-frozen non-triviality gate with median chroma displacement 1.5537 < 3.0
validation_population: new deterministic 100-image ST-context sample excluding all development-100 rows
universal_donor_pool: non-test simultaneously in O, S, T and ST

donor_shortlist.eligible: different canonical video and different environment from target
donor_shortlist.construction: first 16 donors in stable SHA256(target_sample_id | donor_sample_id) order
donor_shortlist.final_choice: maximum normalized chroma palette distance within shortlist
donor_shortlist.palette_distance: Euclidean distance between normalized chroma means plus Frobenius distance between normalized 2x2 chroma covariance matrices

transfer.space: Rec.709 Y plus normalized YCbCr-style chroma

stop_rule: No further naturalistic-colour tuning if v2 fails independent validation. Do not inspect primary test predictions during development.
